body.name: Predictable low-rank experiment class
body.construction: \(\mathfrak P^{\mathrm{pred}}_{n,m}(r,\mu,K,q,B,\lambda)=\{P\in\mathcal P_{n,m}:\text{ assumptions }\mathrm{ass:sequential\mbox{-}randomization},\mathrm{ass:overlap},\mathrm{ass:bounded\mbox{-}outcomes},\mathrm{ass:exact\mbox{-}rank},\mathrm{ass:left\mbox{-}incoherence},\mathrm{ass:signal\mbox{-}floor},\mathrm{ass:aspect\mbox{-}ratio}\text{ hold for the }(n,m)\text{ array}\}\).  This provisional broadening removes right-incoherence and condition-number restrictions: neither is used by the recorded-IPW/hybrid upper proof or by the lower-packing submodel, whose constructed members continue to satisfy the broader member properties.
